text:
erin: Quick ask — need a compact design lane for the launch assets. short turnaround, pls.
This is for the benchmark webinar + 3 social posts + one hero email header.
Requirements:
- single hero diagram (latency vs cost tradeoff) that reads at 600px wide
- 3 social card sizes: 1200x628, 1080x1080, 940x788
- one compressed SVG for blog (accessibility colors)
- export tokens + figma page with components

jordan: Got it. timeline?

erin: 48h quick-turn mock, final by EOD Tue. Need one A variant (lean data-first) and one B variant (brand-forward).
Also we need copy lines for each card — short, punchy. Will drop copy in a sec.

sam: For the hero diagram the data should show: median latency vs token-cost per 1k for 3 configurations (hosted / dedicated / private). CSV attached in the drive link.
Use dashed fallback line to show graceful degradation.

alex: Heads up — for dedicated/dedicated-burst we need to call out SLA-preserved area. Make it a subtle badge on chart.

jordan: Re: accessibility — what contrast targets? we should aim for WCAG AA on body text and AAA for headlines where possible.

maria: Legal check: avoid model vendor logos. Also no direct revenue claims like "50% cheaper" unless we have the test report. Use language like "up to" or "measured savings".

nikhil: For inbound lead routing — include a small CTA on each social variant: "Request a demo" and tag with utm_source=social, campaign=benchmark_launch. We'll need the final filenames to map in our inbound flow.

jordan: Figma page created: https://www.figma.com/file/ABCDEFG/bench-launch-compact — artboards named: hero-600, social-1200x628, social-1080, social-940x788, blog-svg.
Export presets set to png@2x, svg, and webp compressed.

figma-bot: Export queue created for artboard hero-600 (png, svg), social-1200x628 (png@2x), social-1080 (png@2x), social-940x788 (webp).

erin: Copy for A/B — dropping here so you can slot:
A (data): "Serving wins: lower latency, lower unit cost. See the numbers."
B (brand): "Inference engineered for production — predictable, fast, economical."

jordan: Mock in progress. Quick q: do we want sparklines showing day-to-day variance or just medians?

sam: Sparklines ok but keep them small, don't compete with main chart. Use them as micro-variance indicators under the hero.

jordan: Noted. Will deliver 48h mock links in the figma file + a pdf proof.

erin: Thanks team. When you upload finals, please prefix filenames with: benchmark_launch_{variant}_{size}_{date}. e.g. benchmark_launch_A_1200x628_2026-03-24.png

maria: I'll review final visuals for copy/legal once JPG/PNG proofs uploaded. if any claims need citation we flag.

alex: Ops reminder — sync with Eng on routing tags. I'll handle mapping to our inbound pipeline once filenames are final.

nikhil: :thumbsup: prioritizing paid social templates first.

jordan: Uploaded mock v1 — figma link -> same file, page name "mock-v1". feedback welcome.

erin: Reviewing now, will send consolidated feedback in thread.
